// Prisma Schema for DevSecOps AI Platform
// Uses SQLite for development, easily swappable to PostgreSQL

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "sqlite"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

// Using String instead of enums for SQLite compatibility
model User {
  id                    String   @id @default(uuid())
  email                 String   @unique
  passwordHash          String
  name                  String
  avatarUrl             String?
  role                  String   @default("engineer") // admin, engineer, viewer
  theme                 String   @default("system")
  sidebarCollapsed      Boolean  @default(false)
  language              String   @default("en")
  emailNotifications    Boolean  @default(true)
  inAppNotifications    Boolean  @default(true)
  notifyScanComplete    Boolean  @default(true)
  notifyScanFailed      Boolean  @default(true)
  notifyVulnFound       Boolean  @default(true)
  notifyJobChange       Boolean  @default(true)
  lastLoginAt           DateTime?
  createdAt             DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt             DateTime @updatedAt

  scans                 Scan[]
  jobs                  Job[]
  logFiles              LogFile[]
  githubRepos           GitHubRepository[]
  notifications         Notification[]
  settings              Settings?
  apiKeys               ApiKey[]

  @@index([email])
}

model Settings {
  id                    String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId                String   @unique
  user                  User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  // AI Settings
  aiProvider            String   @default("apps_script")
  aiAppsScriptUrl       String?
  aiOpenaiKey           String?  // Encrypted
  aiGeminiKey           String?  // Encrypted
  aiAnthropicKey        String?  // Encrypted
  aiDefaultModel        String   @default("gemini-pro")
  aiTemperature         Float    @default(0.2)
  aiMaxTokens           Int      @default(8192)

  // Docker Settings
  dockerHubUsername     String?
  dockerHubToken        String?  // Encrypted
  dockerRegistry        String   @default("docker.io")
  dockerBuildTimeout    Int      @default(300000)
  dockerScanTimeout     Int      @default(180000)

  // GitHub Settings
  githubAppId           String?
  githubPrivateKey      String?  // Encrypted
  githubWebhookSecret   String?  // Encrypted
  githubDefaultOrg      String?
  githubToken           String?  // Encrypted

  // Scanning Settings (stored as JSON string)
  scanningDefaultTools  String   @default("[\"grype\", \"syft\"]")
  scanningMaxConcurrent Int      @default(3)
  scanningTimeout       Int      @default(600000)

  createdAt             DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt             DateTime @updatedAt
}

model Scan {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid())
  type        String   // dockerfile, docker_image, kubernetes, jenkinsfile, github_repo, dependency, logs
  status      String   @default("pending") // pending, running, completed, failed, cancelled
  targetType  String
  targetValue String
  targetMeta  String?  // JSON string
  summary     String?
  userId      String
  user        User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  jobId       String?  @unique
  job         Job?     @relation(fields: [jobId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  findings    Finding[]
  completedAt DateTime?
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([userId, createdAt])
  @@index([type, status])
}

model Finding {
  id                   String   @id @default(uuid())
  scanId               String
  scan                 Scan     @relation(fields: [scanId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  type                 String   // vulnerability, misconfiguration, secret, bad_practice, syntax_error, security_issue, performance, compliance
  severity             String   // critical, high, medium, low, info
  title                String
  description          String
  file                 String?
  line                 Int?
  column               Int?
  code                 String?
  ruleId               String?
  ruleName             String?
  cve                  String?
  package              String?
  installedVersion     String?
  fixedVersion         String?
  cvssScore            Float?
  cwe                  String?
  references           String   @default("[]") // JSON string
  remediation          String?
  status               String   @default("open") // open, fixed, ignored, in_progress, false_positive
  createdAt            DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt            DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([scanId, severity])
  @@index([cve])
  @@index([package])
}

model Job {
  id           String   @id @default(uuid())
  type         String   // dockerfile_scan, dockerfile_fix, docker_image_scan, docker_image_fix, kubernetes_scan, kubernetes_fix, kubernetes_generate, jenkinsfile_scan, jenkinsfile_fix, jenkinsfile_generate, github_repo_scan, github_dependency_scan, github_secret_scan, github_code_scan, github_code_fix, log_investigation, dependency_scan, dependency_fix, sbom_generation
  status       String   @default("queued") // queued, running, analyzing, fixing, completed, failed, cancelled
  progress     Int      @default(0)
  currentStep  String   @default("")
  totalSteps   Int      @default(1)
  input        String   // JSON string
  output       String?  // JSON string
  error        String?
  startedAt    DateTime?
  completedAt  DateTime?
  userId       String
  user         User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  scanId       String?  @unique
  scan         Scan?    @relation(fields: [scanId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt    DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([userId, createdAt])
  @@index([status])
}

model LogFile {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid())
  name        String
  size        BigInt
  lineCount   Int
  format      String
  indexed     Boolean  @default(false)
  userId      String
  user        User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  entries     LogEntry[]
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([userId, createdAt])
}

model LogEntry {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid())
  logFileId   String
  logFile     LogFile  @relation(fields: [logFileId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  timestamp   DateTime
  level       String
  service     String?
  message     String
  raw         String
  fields      String   @default("{}") // JSON string
  indexed     Boolean  @default(false)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([logFileId, timestamp])
  @@index([logFileId, level])
  @@index([logFileId, service])
}

model GitHubRepository {
  id            String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId        String
  user          User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  githubId      Int      @unique
  name          String
  fullName      String
  url           String
  cloneUrl      String
  defaultBranch String   @default("main")
  private       Boolean  @default(false)
  connectedAt   DateTime @default(now())
  lastScannedAt DateTime?
  scans         GitHubScan[]

  @@index([userId])
}

model GitHubScan {
  id           String   @id @default(uuid())
  repoId       String
  repo         GitHubRepository @relation(fields: [repoId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  branch       String
  commitSha    String
  sbom         String?
  summary      String?
  vulnerabilities String  @default("[]") // JSON string
  secrets      String     @default("[]") // JSON string
  codeIssues   String     @default("[]") // JSON string
  depIssues    String     @default("[]") // JSON string
  scanTime     DateTime   @default(now())
  createdAt    DateTime   @default(now())

  @@index([repoId, scanTime])
}

model Notification {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId    String
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  type      String   // scan_complete, scan_failed, vulnerability_found, job_completed, job_failed, fix_ready, pr_created, system_alert, info
  title     String
  message   String
  read      Boolean  @default(false)
  actionUrl String?
  metadata  String?  // JSON string
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([userId, read, createdAt])
}

model ApiKey {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  name      String
  keyHash   String   @unique
  prefix    String
  userId    String
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  lastUsedAt DateTime?
  expiresAt DateTime?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  revokedAt DateTime?

  @@index([userId])
}

model AuditLog {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId    String?
  action    String
  resource  String
  resourceId String?
  metadata  String?  // JSON string
  ip        String?
  userAgent String?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([userId, createdAt])
  @@index([resource, resourceId])
}

// Prisma Schema for DevSecOps AI Platform
// Uses SQLite for development, easily swappable to PostgreSQL

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "sqlite"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

// Using String instead of enums for SQLite compatibility
model User {
  id                    String   @id @default(uuid())
  email                 String   @unique
  passwordHash          String
  name                  String
  avatarUrl             String?
  role                  String   @default("engineer") // admin, engineer, viewer
  theme                 String   @default("system")
  sidebarCollapsed      Boolean  @default(false)
  language              String   @default("en")
  emailNotifications    Boolean  @default(true)
  inAppNotifications    Boolean  @default(true)
  notifyScanComplete    Boolean  @default(true)
  notifyScanFailed      Boolean  @default(true)
  notifyVulnFound       Boolean  @default(true)
  notifyJobChange       Boolean  @default(true)
  lastLoginAt           DateTime?
  createdAt             DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt             DateTime @updatedAt

  scans                 Scan[]
  jobs                  Job[]
  logFiles              LogFile[]
  githubRepos           GitHubRepository[]
  notifications         Notification[]
  settings              Settings?
  apiKeys               ApiKey[]

  @@index([email])
}

model Settings {
  id                    String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId                String   @unique
  user                  User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  // AI Settings
  aiProvider            String   @default("apps_script")
  aiAppsScriptUrl       String?
  aiOpenaiKey           String?  // Encrypted
  aiGeminiKey           String?  // Encrypted
  aiAnthropicKey        String?  // Encrypted
  aiDefaultModel        String   @default("gemini-pro")
  aiTemperature         Float    @default(0.2)
  aiMaxTokens           Int      @default(8192)

  // Docker Settings
  dockerHubUsername     String?
  dockerHubToken        String?  // Encrypted
  dockerRegistry        String   @default("docker.io")
  dockerBuildTimeout    Int      @default(300000)
  dockerScanTimeout     Int      @default(180000)

  // GitHub Settings
  githubAppId           String?
  githubPrivateKey      String?  // Encrypted
  githubWebhookSecret   String?  // Encrypted
  githubDefaultOrg      String?
  githubToken           String?  // Encrypted

  // Scanning Settings (stored as JSON string)
  scanningDefaultTools  String   @default("[\"grype\", \"syft\"]")
  scanningMaxConcurrent Int      @default(3)
  scanningTimeout       Int      @default(600000)

  createdAt             DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt             DateTime @updatedAt
}

model Scan {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid())
  type        String   // dockerfile, docker_image, kubernetes, jenkinsfile, github_repo, dependency, logs
  status      String   @default("pending") // pending, running, completed, failed, cancelled
  targetType  String
  targetValue String
  targetMeta  String?  // JSON string
  summary     String?
  userId      String
  user        User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  jobId       String?  @unique
  findings    Finding[]
  completedAt DateTime?
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([userId, createdAt])
  @@index([type, status])
}

model Finding {
  id                   String   @id @default(uuid())
  scanId               String
  scan                 Scan     @relation(fields: [scanId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  type                 String   // vulnerability, misconfiguration, secret, bad_practice, syntax_error, security_issue, performance, compliance
  severity             String   // critical, high, medium, low, info
  title                String
  description          String
  file                 String?
  line                 Int?
  column               Int?
  code                 String?
  ruleId               String?
  ruleName             String?
  cve                  String?
  package              String?
  installedVersion     String?
  fixedVersion         String?
  cvssScore            Float?
  cwe                  String?
  references           String   @default("[]") // JSON string
  remediation          String?
  status               String   @default("open") // open, fixed, ignored, in_progress, false_positive
  createdAt            DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt            DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([scanId, severity])
  @@index([cve])
  @@index([package])
}

model Job {
  id           String   @id @default(uuid())
  type         String   // dockerfile_scan, dockerfile_fix, docker_image_scan, docker_image_fix, kubernetes_scan, kubernetes_fix, kubernetes_generate, jenkinsfile_scan, jenkinsfile_fix, jenkinsfile_generate, github_repo_scan, github_dependency_scan, github_secret_scan, github_code_scan, github_code_fix, log_investigation, dependency_scan, dependency_fix, sbom_generation
  status       String   @default("queued") // queued, running, analyzing, fixing, completed, failed, cancelled
  progress     Int      @default(0)
  currentStep  String   @default("")
  totalSteps   Int      @default(1)
  input        String   // JSON string
  output       String?  // JSON string
  error        String?
  startedAt    DateTime?
  completedAt  DateTime?
  userId       String
  user         User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  scanId       String?  @unique
  scan         Scan?    @relation(fields: [scanId], references: [id])
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt    DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([userId, createdAt])
  @@index([status])
}

model LogFile {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid())
  name        String
  size        BigInt
  lineCount   Int
  format      String
  indexed     Boolean  @default(false)
  userId      String
  user        User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  entries     LogEntry[]
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([userId, createdAt])
}

model LogEntry {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid())
  logFileId   String
  logFile     LogFile  @relation(fields: [logFileId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  timestamp   DateTime
  level       String
  service     String?
  message     String
  raw         String
  fields      String   @default("{}") // JSON string
  indexed     Boolean  @default(false)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([logFileId, timestamp])
  @@index([logFileId, level])
  @@index([logFileId, service])
}

model GitHubRepository {
  id            String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId        String
  user          User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  githubId      Int      @unique
  name          String
  fullName      String
  url           String
  cloneUrl      String
  defaultBranch String   @default("main")
  private       Boolean  @default(false)
  connectedAt   DateTime @default(now())
  lastScannedAt DateTime?
  scans         GitHubScan[]

  @@index([userId])
}

model GitHubScan {
  id           String   @id @default(uuid())
  repoId       String
  repo         GitHubRepository @relation(fields: [repoId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  branch       String
  commitSha    String
  sbom         String?
  summary      String?
  vulnerabilities String  @default("[]") // JSON string
  secrets      String     @default("[]") // JSON string
  codeIssues   String     @default("[]") // JSON string
  depIssues    String     @default("[]") // JSON string
  scanTime     DateTime   @default(now())
  createdAt    DateTime   @default(now())

  @@index([repoId, scanTime])
}

model Notification {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId    String
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  type      String   // scan_complete, scan_failed, vulnerability_found, job_completed, job_failed, fix_ready, pr_created, system_alert, info
  title     String
  message   String
  read      Boolean  @default(false)
  actionUrl String?
  metadata  String?  // JSON string
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([userId, read, createdAt])
}

model ApiKey {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  name      String
  keyHash   String   @unique
  prefix    String
  userId    String
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  lastUsedAt DateTime?
  expiresAt DateTime?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  revokedAt DateTime?

  @@index([userId])
}

model AuditLog {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId    String?
  action    String
  resource  String
  resourceId String?
  metadata  String?  // JSON string
  ip        String?
  userAgent String?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([userId, createdAt])
  @@index([resource, resourceId])
}

message.content:
This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.

Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   User wants a complete production-ready DevSecOps AI Platform with 9 major features: Dashboard, Dockerfile Fixer, Docker Image Scanner, Kubernetes YAML Assistant, Jenkins Assistant, GitHub Security, Log Investigation, Dependency Radar, Scan History, plus shared AI service, job queue, real-time updates, and modern SaaS UI. The platform must use real security tools (Grype, Syft, Trivy, Semgrep, Gitleaks) not mocked results. User explicitly requested SQLite for database and confirmed to install all missing tools.

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - Monorepo with npm workspaces (frontend, backend, shared)
   - React 18 + Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS (dark-first theme)
   - Fastify + TypeScript backend with Prisma ORM (SQLite dev, Postgres ready)
   - BullMQ + Redis for async job processing with WebSocket real-time updates
   - Monaco Editor for code editing with diff viewer
   - AI Provider abstraction (AppsScriptProvider default, extensible for OpenAI/Gemini/Anthropic)
   - JWT authentication with refresh tokens, bcrypt password hashing
   - Comprehensive type system in @devsecops/shared package (1000+ lines of types)
   - Real security tool integration (not mocked)

3. Files and Code Sections:
   - **Frontend Pages**: All 11 pages created (Dashboard, DockerfileFixer, DockerScanner, KubernetesAssistant, JenkinsAssistant, GitHubSecurity, LogInvestigation, DependencyRadar, ScanHistory, Settings, Login, Register) with lazy loading
   - **Backend Routes**: 13 route modules (auth, dockerfile, docker, kubernetes, jenkins, github, logs, dependencies, scans, settings, ai, jobs, modules/routes.ts)
   - **Scanner Modules**: 6 scanner modules (dockerfile/scanners, kubernetes/scanners, jenkins/scanners, github/scanners, dependencies/scanners, logs/scanners)
   - **Queue Workers**: Updated /backend/src/shared/queue/index.ts with actual scanner implementations
   - **Prisma Schema**: Fixed for SQLite compatibility in /backend/prisma/schema.prisma (removed enums, Json types, String[] arrays, fixed one-to-one relations)
   - **Audit Utility**: Created /backend/src/shared/utils/audit.ts
   - **AI Service**: Added getAIProvider export in /backend/src/shared/ai/index.ts
   - **Fastify Types**: Created /backend/src/types/fastify.d.ts for TypeScript declarations

4. Errors and Fixes:
   - **Docker daemon not running** → Started Docker Desktop, verified with `docker info`
   - **Missing security tools** (syft, trivy, gitleaks, semgrep) → Installed via Homebrew (syft, trivy, gitleaks) and pipx (semgrep) due to Python externally managed environment
   - **Login.tsx Shield import at bottom** → Moved import to top with other imports, removed duplicate
   - **TypeScript compilation error in jenkins scanner** (missing closing brace) → Fixed by adding missing brace
   - **Prisma schema validation errors for SQLite** (Json types, String[] arrays, relation issues) → Fixed by converting Json to String with JSON string defaults, String[] to String with JSON string defaults, fixing one-to-one relations with @unique constraints, removing onDelete/onUpdate from one side of bidirectional relations
   - **Missing auditLog module** → Created /backend/src/shared/utils/audit.ts   - **Missing getAIProvider export** → Added export function to /backend/src/shared/ai/index.ts
   - **TypeScript errors in route handlers** (request.body typing) → Fixed by adding explicit type assertions with `as` keyword
   - **createJob function signature mismatch** → Updated all route calls from `createJob(type, data, userId)` to `createJob({ type, input, userId, scanId })`
   - **Finding references field type mismatch** (string[] vs String in Prisma) → Used JSON.stringify for array fields in all scanner modules

5. Problem Solving:
   - Created comprehensive shared type system (1000+ lines) to ensure frontend/backend type safety
   - Designed AI provider abstraction to avoid hardcoding Apps Script logic throughout
   - Implemented job queue architecture with progress tracking via WebSocket
   - Built reusable components (DiffViewer, CodeEditor, FindingCard, FindingList) for consistent UX across features
   - Used lazy loading for all pages to optimize bundle size
   - Created complete Prisma schema with 12 models covering users, scans, findings, jobs, logs, GitHub repos, notifications, API keys, audit logs, settings
   - Fixed bidirectional relation issues in Prisma by removing relation fields from one side

6. All User Messages:
   - Initial massive project specification (20 features detailed with exact requirements for each page, component, API endpoint)
   - "hi" greeting
   - "Which database?" → Answered: SQLite
   - "Install missing tools?" → Answered: Install all

7. Pending Tasks:
   - Fix remaining TypeScript compilation errors across all route modules
   - Run `npx prisma generate` successfully
   - Run `npx prisma db push` to create database schema
   - Test backend compiles (`npx tsc --noEmit`)
   - Start backend server and verify it runs
   - Implement Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml, .env.example for deployment
   - Test end-to-end workflows
   - Implement WebSocket real-time job progress updates in frontend hooks
   - Add proper error boundaries and loading states

8. Current Work:
   Just fixed multiple TypeScript compilation errors by adding explicit type assertions to request.body in route handlers and updating createJob calls to use the new object-based signature. Fixed Prisma schema for SQLite compatibility (removed enums, Json types, String[] arrays, fixed relation issues). // Prisma Schema for DevSecOps AI Platform
// Uses SQLite for development, easily swappable to PostgreSQL

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "sqlite"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

// Using String instead of enums for SQLite compatibility
model User {
  id                    String   @id @default(uuid())
  email                 String   @unique
  passwordHash          String
  name                  String
  avatarUrl             String?
  role                  String   @default("engineer") // admin, engineer, viewer
  theme                 String   @default("system")
  sidebarCollapsed      Boolean  @default(false)
  language              String   @default("en")
  emailNotifications    Boolean  @default(true)
  inAppNotifications    Boolean  @default(true)
  notifyScanComplete    Boolean  @default(true)
  notifyScanFailed      Boolean  @default(true)
  notifyVulnFound       Boolean  @default(true)
  notifyJobChange       Boolean  @default(true)
  lastLoginAt           DateTime?
  createdAt             DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt             DateTime @updatedAt

  scans                 Scan[]
  jobs                  Job[]
  logFiles              LogFile[]
  githubRepos           GitHubRepository[]
  notifications         Notification[]
  settings              Settings?
  apiKeys               ApiKey[]

  @@index([email])
}

model Settings {
  id                    String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId                String   @unique
  user                  User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  // AI Settings
  aiProvider            String   @default("apps_script")
  aiAppsScriptUrl       String?
  aiOpenaiKey           String?  // Encrypted
  aiGeminiKey           String?  // Encrypted
  aiAnthropicKey        String?  // Encrypted
  aiDefaultModel        String   @default("gemini-pro")
  aiTemperature         Float    @default(0.2)
  aiMaxTokens           Int      @default(8192)

  // Docker Settings
  dockerHubUsername     String?
  dockerHubToken        String?  // Encrypted
  dockerRegistry        String   @default("docker.io")
  dockerBuildTimeout    Int      @default(300000)
  dockerScanTimeout     Int      @default(180000)

  // GitHub Settings
  githubAppId           String?
  githubPrivateKey      String?  // Encrypted
  githubWebhookSecret   String?  // Encrypted
  githubDefaultOrg      String?
  githubToken           String?  // Encrypted

  // Scanning Settings (stored as JSON string)
  scanningDefaultTools  String   @default("[\"grype\", \"syft\"]")
  scanningMaxConcurrent Int      @default(3)
  scanningTimeout       Int      @default(600000)

  createdAt             DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt             DateTime @updatedAt
}

model Scan {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid())
  type        String   // dockerfile, docker_image, kubernetes, jenkinsfile, github_repo, dependency, logs
  status      String   @default("pending") // pending, running, completed, failed, cancelled
  targetType  String
  targetValue String
  targetMeta  String?  // JSON string
  summary     String?
  userId      String
  user        User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  jobId       String?  @unique
  findings    Finding[]
  completedAt DateTime?
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([userId, createdAt])
  @@index([type, status])

// Prisma Schema for DevSecOps AI Platform
// Uses SQLite for development, easily swappable to PostgreSQL

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "sqlite"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

// Using String instead of enums for SQLite compatibility
model User {
  id                    String   @id @default(uuid())
  email                 String   @unique
  passwordHash          String
  name                  String
  avatarUrl             String?
  role                  String   @default("engineer") // admin, engineer, viewer
  theme                 String   @default("system")
  sidebarCollapsed      Boolean  @default(false)
  language              String   @default("en")
  emailNotifications    Boolean  @default(true)
  inAppNotifications    Boolean  @default(true)
  notifyScanComplete    Boolean  @default(true)
  notifyScanFailed      Boolean  @default(true)
  notifyVulnFound       Boolean  @default(true)
  notifyJobChange       Boolean  @default(true)
  lastLoginAt           DateTime?
  createdAt             DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt             DateTime @updatedAt

  scans                 Scan[]
  jobs                  Job[]
  logFiles              LogFile[]
  githubRepos           GitHubRepository[]
  notifications         Notification[]
  settings              Settings?
  apiKeys               ApiKey[]

  @@index([email])
}

model Settings {
  id                    String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId                String   @unique
  user                  User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  // AI Settings
  aiProvider            String   @default("apps_script")
  aiAppsScriptUrl       String?
  aiOpenaiKey           String?  // Encrypted
  aiGeminiKey           String?  // Encrypted
  aiAnthropicKey        String?  // Encrypted
  aiDefaultModel        String   @default("gemini-pro")
  aiTemperature         Float    @default(0.2)
  aiMaxTokens           Int      @default(8192)

  // Docker Settings
  dockerHubUsername     String?
  dockerHubToken        String?  // Encrypted
  dockerRegistry        String   @default("docker.io")
  dockerBuildTimeout    Int      @default(300000)
  dockerScanTimeout     Int      @default(180000)

  // GitHub Settings
  githubAppId           String?
  githubPrivateKey      String?  // Encrypted
  githubWebhookSecret   String?  // Encrypted
  githubDefaultOrg      String?
  githubToken           String?  // Encrypted

  // Scanning Settings (stored as JSON string)
  scanningDefaultTools  String   @default("[\"grype\", \"syft\"]")
  scanningMaxConcurrent Int      @default(3)
  scanningTimeout       Int      @default(600000)

  createdAt             DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt             DateTime @updatedAt
}

model Scan {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid())
  type        String   // dockerfile, docker_image, kubernetes, jenkinsfile, github_repo, dependency, logs
  status      String   @default("pending") // pending, running, completed, failed, cancelled
  targetType  String
  targetValue String
  targetMeta  String?  // JSON string
  summary     String?
  userId      String
  user        User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  jobId       String?  @unique
  findings    Finding[]
  completedAt DateTime?
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([userId, createdAt])
  @@index([type, status])
}

model Finding {
  id                   String   @id @default(uuid())
  scanId               String
  scan                 Scan     @relation(fields: [scanId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  type                 String   // vulnerability, misconfiguration, secret, bad_practice, syntax_error, security_issue, performance, compliance
  severity             String   // critical, high, medium, low, info
  title                String
  description          String
  file                 String?
  line                 Int?
  column               Int?
  code                 String?
  ruleId               String?
  ruleName             String?
  cve                  String?
  package              String?
  installedVersion     String?
  fixedVersion         String?
  cvssScore            Float?
  cwe                  String?
  references           String   @default("[]") // JSON string
  remediation          String?
  status               String   @default("open") // open, fixed, ignored, in_progress, false_positive
  createdAt            DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt            DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([scanId, severity])
  @@index([cve])
  @@index([package])
}

model Job {
  id           String   @id @default(uuid())
  type         String   // dockerfile_scan, dockerfile_fix, docker_image_scan, docker_image_fix, kubernetes_scan, kubernetes_fix, kubernetes_generate, jenkinsfile_scan, jenkinsfile_fix, jenkinsfile_generate, github_repo_scan, github_dependency_scan, github_secret_scan, github_code_scan, github_code_fix, log_investigation, dependency_scan, dependency_fix, sbom_generation
  status       String   @default("queued") // queued, running, analyzing, fixing, completed, failed, cancelled
  progress     Int      @default(0)
  currentStep  String   @default("")
  totalSteps   Int      @default(1)
  input        String   // JSON string
  output       String?  // JSON string
  error        String?
  startedAt    DateTime?
  completedAt  DateTime?
  userId       String
  user         User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  scanId       String?  @unique
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt    DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([userId, createdAt])
  @@index([status])
}

model LogFile {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid())
  name        String
  size        BigInt
  lineCount   Int
  format      String
  indexed     Boolean  @default(false)
  userId      String
  user        User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  entries     LogEntry[]
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([userId, createdAt])
}

model LogEntry {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid())
  logFileId   String
  logFile     LogFile  @relation(fields: [logFileId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  timestamp   DateTime
  level       String
  service     String?
  message     String
  raw         String
  fields      String   @default("{}") // JSON string
  indexed     Boolean  @default(false)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([logFileId, timestamp])
  @@index([logFileId, level])
  @@index([logFileId, service])
}

model GitHubRepository {
  id            String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId        String
  user          User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  githubId      Int      @unique
  name          String
  fullName      String
  url           String
  cloneUrl      String
  defaultBranch String   @default("main")
  private       Boolean  @default(false)
  connectedAt   DateTime @default(now())
  lastScannedAt DateTime?
  scans         GitHubScan[]

  @@index([userId])
}

model GitHubScan {
  id           String   @id @default(uuid())
  repoId       String
  repo         GitHubRepository @relation(fields: [repoId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  branch       String
  commitSha    String
  sbom         String?
  summary      String?
  vulnerabilities String  @default("[]") // JSON string
  secrets      String     @default("[]") // JSON string
  codeIssues   String     @default("[]") // JSON string
  depIssues    String     @default("[]") // JSON string
  scanTime     DateTime   @default(now())
  createdAt    DateTime   @default(now())

  @@index([repoId, scanTime])
}

model Notification {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId    String
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  type      String   // scan_complete, scan_failed, vulnerability_found, job_completed, job_failed, fix_ready, pr_created, system_alert, info
  title     String
  message   String
  read      Boolean  @default(false)
  actionUrl String?
  metadata  String?  // JSON string
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([userId, read, createdAt])
}

model ApiKey {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  name      String
  keyHash   String   @unique
  prefix    String
  userId    String
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  lastUsedAt DateTime?
  expiresAt DateTime?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  revokedAt DateTime?

  @@index([userId])
}

model AuditLog {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId    String?
  action    String
  resource  String
  resourceId String?
  metadata  String?  // JSON string
  ip        String?
  userAgent String?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([userId, createdAt])
  @@index([resource, resourceId])
}

// Prisma Schema for DevSecOps AI Platform
// Uses SQLite for development, easily swappable to PostgreSQL

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "sqlite"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

// Using String instead of enums for SQLite compatibility
model User {
  id                    String   @id @default(uuid())
  email                 String   @unique
  passwordHash          String
  name                  String
  avatarUrl             String?
  role                  String   @default("engineer") // admin, engineer, viewer
  theme                 String   @default("system")
  sidebarCollapsed      Boolean  @default(false)
  language              String   @default("en")
  emailNotifications    Boolean  @default(true)
  inAppNotifications    Boolean  @default(true)
  notifyScanComplete    Boolean  @default(true)
  notifyScanFailed      Boolean  @default(true)
  notifyVulnFound       Boolean  @default(true)
  notifyJobChange       Boolean  @default(true)
  lastLoginAt           DateTime?
  createdAt             DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt             DateTime @updatedAt

  scans                 Scan[]
  jobs                  Job[]
  logFiles              LogFile[]
  githubRepos           GitHubRepository[]
  notifications         Notification[]
  settings              Settings?
  apiKeys               ApiKey[]

  @@index([email])
}

model Settings {
  id                    String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId                String   @unique
  user                  User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  // AI Settings
  aiProvider            String   @default("apps_script")
  aiAppsScriptUrl       String?
  aiOpenaiKey           String?  // Encrypted
  aiGeminiKey           String?  // Encrypted
  aiAnthropicKey        String?  // Encrypted
  aiDefaultModel        String   @default("gemini-pro")
  aiTemperature         Float    @default(0.2)
  aiMaxTokens           Int      @default(8192)

  // Docker Settings
  dockerHubUsername     String?
  dockerHubToken        String?  // Encrypted
  dockerRegistry        String   @default("docker.io")
  dockerBuildTimeout    Int      @default(300000)
  dockerScanTimeout     Int      @default(180000)

  // GitHub Settings
  githubAppId           String?
  githubPrivateKey      String?  // Encrypted
  githubWebhookSecret   String?  // Encrypted
  githubDefaultOrg      String?
  githubToken           String?  // Encrypted

  // Other Integrations
  gitlabToken           String?  // Encrypted
  bitbucketToken        String?  // Encrypted
  slackWebhook          String?
  teamsWebhook          String?
  jiraUrl               String?
  jiraToken             String?  // Encrypted
  webhookUrl            String?
  webhookSecret         String?

  // Scanning Settings (stored as JSON string)
  scanningDefaultTools  String   @default("[\"grype\", \"syft\"]")
  scanningMaxConcurrent Int      @default(3)
  scanningTimeout       Int      @default(600000)

  // Advanced
  debugMode             Boolean  @default(false)
  telemetryEnabled      Boolean  @default(true)
  autoUpdate            Boolean  @default(true)

  createdAt             DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt             DateTime @updatedAt
}

model Scan {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid())
  type        String   // dockerfile, docker_image, kubernetes, jenkinsfile, github_repo, dependency, logs
  status      String   @default("pending") // pending, running, completed, failed, cancelled
  targetType  String
  targetValue String
  targetMeta  String?  // JSON string
  summary     String?
  userId      String
  user        User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  jobId       String?  @unique
  findings    Finding[]
  completedAt DateTime?
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([userId, createdAt])
  @@index([type, status])
}

model Finding {
  id                   String   @id @default(uuid())
  scanId               String
  scan                 Scan     @relation(fields: [scanId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  type                 String   // vulnerability, misconfiguration, secret, bad_practice, syntax_error, security_issue, performance, compliance
  severity             String   // critical, high, medium, low, info
  title                String
  description          String
  file                 String?
  line                 Int?
  column               Int?
  code                 String?
  ruleId               String?
  ruleName             String?
  cve                  String?
  package              String?
  installedVersion     String?
  fixedVersion         String?
  cvssScore            Float?
  cwe                  String?
  references           String   @default("[]") // JSON string
  remediation          String?
  status               String   @default("open") // open, fixed, ignored, in_progress, false_positive
  createdAt            DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt            DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([scanId, severity])
  @@index([cve])
  @@index([package])
}

model Job {
  id           String   @id @default(uuid())
  type         String   // dockerfile_scan, dockerfile_fix, docker_image_scan, docker_image_fix, kubernetes_scan, kubernetes_fix, kubernetes_generate, jenkinsfile_scan, jenkinsfile_fix, jenkinsfile_generate, github_repo_scan, github_dependency_scan, github_secret_scan, github_code_scan, github_code_fix, log_investigation, dependency_scan, dependency_fix, sbom_generation
  status       String   @default("queued") // queued, running, analyzing, fixing, completed, failed, cancelled
  progress     Int      @default(0)
  currentStep  String   @default("")
  totalSteps   Int      @default(1)
  input        String   // JSON string
  output       String?  // JSON string
  error        String?
  startedAt    DateTime?
  completedAt  DateTime?
  userId       String
  user         User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  scanId       String?  @unique
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt    DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([userId, createdAt])
  @@index([status])
}

model LogFile {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid())
  name        String
  size        BigInt
  lineCount   Int
  format      String
  indexed     Boolean  @default(false)
  userId      String
  user        User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  entries     LogEntry[]
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([userId, createdAt])
}

model LogEntry {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid())
  logFileId   String
  logFile     LogFile  @relation(fields: [logFileId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  timestamp   DateTime
  level       String
  service     String?
  message     String
  raw         String
  fields      String   @default("{}") // JSON string
  indexed     Boolean  @default(false)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([logFileId, timestamp])
  @@index([logFileId, level])
  @@index([logFileId, service])
}

model GitHubRepository {
  id            String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId        String
  user          User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  githubId      Int      @unique
  name          String
  fullName      String
  url           String
  cloneUrl      String
  defaultBranch String   @default("main")
  private       Boolean  @default(false)
  connectedAt   DateTime @default(now())
  lastScannedAt DateTime?
  scans         GitHubScan[]

  @@index([userId])
}

model GitHubScan {
  id           String   @id @default(uuid())
  repoId       String
  repo         GitHubRepository @relation(fields: [repoId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  branch       String
  commitSha    String
  sbom         String?
  summary      String?
  vulnerabilities String  @default("[]") // JSON string
  secrets      String     @default("[]") // JSON string
  codeIssues   String     @default("[]") // JSON string
  depIssues    String     @default("[]") // JSON string
  scanTime     DateTime   @default(now())
  createdAt    DateTime   @default(now())

  @@index([repoId, scanTime])
}

model Notification {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId    String
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  type      String   // scan_complete, scan_failed, vulnerability_found, job_completed, job_failed, fix_ready, pr_created, system_alert, info
  title     String
  message   String
  read      Boolean  @default(false)
  actionUrl String?
  metadata  String?  // JSON string
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([userId, read, createdAt])
}

model ApiKey {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  name      String
  keyHash   String   @unique
  prefix    String
  userId    String
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  lastUsedAt DateTime?
  expiresAt DateTime?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  revokedAt DateTime?

  @@index([userId])
}

model AuditLog {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId    String?
  action    String
  resource  String
  resourceId String?
  metadata  String?  // JSON string
  ip        String?
  userAgent String?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([userId, createdAt])
  @@index([resource, resourceId])
}

- Explore: Read-only search agent for broad fan-out searches — when answering means sweeping many files, directories, or naming conventions and you only need the conclusion, not the file dumps. It reads excerpts rather than whole files, so it locates code; it doesn't review or audit it. Specify search breadth: "medium" for moderate exploration, "very thorough" for multiple locations and naming conventions. (Tools: All tools except Agent, Artifact, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)

- general-purpose: General-purpose agent for researching complex questions, searching for code, and executing multi-step tasks. When you are searching for a keyword or file and are not confident that you will find the right match in the first few tries use this agent to perform the search for you. (Tools: *)

- Plan: Software architect agent for designing implementation plans. Use this when you need to plan the implementation strategy for a task. Returns step-by-step plans, identifies critical files, and considers architectural trade-offs. (Tools: All tools except Agent, Artifact, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)

model Settings {
  id                    String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId                String   @unique
  user                  User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  // AI Settings
  aiProvider            String   @default("apps_script")
  aiAppsScriptUrl       String?
  aiOpenaiKey           String?  // Encrypted
  aiGeminiKey           String?  // Encrypted
  aiAnthropicKey        String?  // Encrypted
  aiDefaultModel        String   @default("gemini-pro")
  aiTemperature         Float    @default(0.2)
  aiMaxTokens           Int      @default(8192)

  // Docker Settings
  dockerHubUsername     String?
  dockerHubToken        String?  // Encrypted
  dockerRegistry        String   @default("docker.io")
  dockerBuildTimeout    Int      @default(300000)
  dockerScanTimeout     Int      @default(180000)

  // GitHub Settings
  githubAppId           String?
  githubPrivateKey      String?  // Encrypted
  githubWebhookSecret   String?  // Encrypted
  githubDefaultOrg      String?
  githubToken           String?  // Encrypted

  // Other Integrations
  gitlabToken           String?  // Encrypted
  bitbucketToken        String?  // Encrypted
  slackWebhook          String?
  teamsWebhook          String?
  jiraUrl               String?
  jiraToken             String?  // Encrypted
  webhookUrl            String?
  webhookSecret         String?

  // Scanning Settings (stored as JSON string)
  scanningDefaultTools  String   @default("[\"grype\", \"syft\"]")
  scanningMaxConcurrent Int      @default(3)
  scanningTimeout       Int      @default(600000)

  // Advanced
  debugMode             Boolean  @default(false)
  telemetryEnabled      Boolean  @default(true)
  autoUpdate            Boolean  @default(true)

  createdAt             DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt             DateTime @updatedAt
}

model Scan {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid())
  type        String   // dockerfile, docker_image, kubernetes, jenkinsfile, github_repo, dependency, logs
  status      String   @default("pending") // pending, running, completed, failed, cancelled
  targetType  String
  targetValue String
  targetMeta  String?  // JSON string

This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.

Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   User wants a complete production-ready DevSecOps AI Platform with 9 major features: Dashboard, Dockerfile Fixer, Docker Image Scanner, Kubernetes YAML Assistant, Jenkins Assistant, GitHub Security, Log Investigation, Dependency Radar, Scan History, plus shared AI service, job queue, real-time updates, and modern SaaS UI. Must use REAL security tools (Grype, Syft, Trivy, Semgrep, Gitleaks) - no mocked results. User explicitly confirmed SQLite for database and authorized installation of all missing tools.

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - Monorepo with npm workspaces (frontend, backend, shared packages)
   - Frontend: React 18 + Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS (dark-first theme), Monaco Editor, lazy loading
   - Backend: Fastify + TypeScript + Prisma ORM (SQLite dev, Postgres ready)
   - Job Queue: BullMQ + Redis for async processing with WebSocket real-time progress updates
   - AI Provider abstraction: AppsScriptProvider default, extensible for OpenAI/Gemini/Anthropic
   - Auth: JWT with refresh tokens, bcrypt password hashing
   - Shared types package: 1000+ lines covering all domain entities
   - Real security tool integration: Grype, Syft, Trivy, Semgrep, Gitleaks, kubeconform, checkov

3. Files and Code Sections:
   - **backend/prisma/schema.prisma**: Fixed SQLite compatibility - Json→String with JSON defaults, String[]→String with JSON defaults, fixed bidirectional relations with @unique, removed onDelete/onUpdate from one side
   - **backend/src/shared/utils/audit.ts**: Created new audit logging utility with JSON.stringify for metadata
   - **backend/src/shared/ai/index.ts**: Added getAIProvider export, fixed AIProviderConfig import from shared types
   - **backend/src/modules/settings/routes.ts**: Added explicit z.infer type assertions for request.body
   - **backend/src/modules/scans/routes.ts**: Fixed request.body typing, removed 'name' from select (Scan model uses targetValue)
   - **backend/src/shared/queue/index.ts**: Major refactor - fixed BullMQ jobTimeout→jobTimeout removal, createJob type casting, processJob switch with helper variables for type safety
   - **backend/src/shared/websocket/index.ts**: Installed @types/ws, fixed req.query typing, message/error handler types
   - **backend/src/modules/routes.ts**: Removed duplicate /health route
   - **shared/package.json**: Removed "type": "module" to fix CommonJS/ESM interop
   - **shared/src/index.ts**: Fixed relative imports

4. Errors and fixes:
   - **Docker daemon not running** → Started Docker Desktop, verified with `docker info`
   - **Missing security tools** → Installed syft, trivy, gitleaks via Homebrew; semgrep via pipx (Python externally managed)
   - **Login.tsx Shield import at bottom** → Moved import to top, removed duplicate
   - **TypeScript error in jenkins scanner** (missing closing brace) → Added missing brace
   - **Prisma schema validation for SQLite** → Converted Json to String with JSON defaults, String[] to String with JSON defaults, fixed one-to-one relations with @unique, removed onDelete/onUpdate from one side of bidirectional relations
   - **Missing auditLog module** → Created backend/src/shared/utils/audit.ts
   - **Missing getAIProvider export** → Added to backend/src/shared/ai/index.ts
   - **TypeScript errors in route handlers** (request.body typing) → Added explicit type assertions with `as` keyword
   - **createJob function signature mismatch** → Updated all route calls from `createJob(type, data, userId)` to `createJob({ type, input, userId, scanId })`
   - **Finding references field type mismatch** (string[] vs String in Prisma) → Used JSON.stringify for array fields in all scanner modules
   - **JobType union missing types** → Added github_code_fix, log_search, log_parse to shared types
   - **Settings model missing fields** → Added gitlabToken, bitbucketToken, slackWebhook, teamsWebhook, jiraUrl, jiraToken, webhookUrl, webhookSecret, debugMode, telemetryEnabled, autoUpdate
   - **Shared package ESM/CommonJS conflict** → Removed "type": "module" from shared/package.json
   - **Queue/index.ts type errors** → Refactored with helper variables, fixed BullMQ jobTimeout option
   - **WebSocket type errors** → Installed @types/ws, fixed req.query as Record<string, string|undefined>, message handler data type, error handler type
   - **Duplicate /health route** → Removed from modules/routes.ts (already in index.ts)
   - **Fastify schema validation error** (current) → "Failed building the validation schema for POST: /api/auth/login, due to error schema is invalid: data/required must be array" - zod schema issue with fastify-type-provider-zod

5. Problem Solving:
   - Created comprehensive shared type system (1000+ lines) for frontend/backend type safety
   - Designed AI provider abstraction to avoid hardcoding Apps Script logic
   - Implemented job queue architecture with progress tracking via WebSocket
   - Built reusable components (DiffViewer, CodeEditor, FindingCard, FindingList) for consistent UX
   - Used lazy loading for all pages to optimize bundle size
   - Fixed Prisma bidirectional relation issues by removing relation fields from one side
   - Consolidated all scanner modules to use real security tools with proper error handling

6. All user messages:
   - Initial massive project specification (20+ features with exact requirements for each page, component, API endpoint)
   - "hi" greeting
   - "Which database?" → Answered: SQLite
   - "Install missing tools?" → Answered: Install all

7. Pending Tasks:
   - Fix Fastify zod schema validation error for /api/auth/login route
   - Test backend server runs successfully
   - Implement Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml, .env.example for deployment
   - Test end-to-end workflows
   - Implement WebSocket real-time job progress updates in frontend hooks
   - Add proper error boundaries and loading states

8. Current Work:
   Just fixed all TypeScript compilation errors. Backend builds successfully (`npm run build` completes). Database schema pushed (`npx prisma db push` successful). However, server fails to start due to Fastify zod schema validation error: "Failed building the validation schema for POST: /api/auth/login, due to error schema is invalid: data/required must be array". This appears to be a zod-to-fastify-schema conversion issue with fastify-type-provider-zod.

9. Optional Next Step:
   Fix the zod schema validation error in backend/src/modules/auth/routes.ts for the login route. The issue is likely with how the zod schema is being passed to fastify-type-provider-zod. Need to check if the schema format needs adjustment or if there's a version compatibility issue.

message.content:
This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.

Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   - User wants a complete production-ready DevSecOps AI Platform with 9 major features (Dashboard, Dockerfile Fixer, Docker Image Scanner, Kubernetes YAML Assistant, Jenkins Assistant, GitHub Security, Log Investigation, Dependency Radar, Scan History) plus shared AI service, job queue, real-time updates, and modern SaaS UI
   - Must use REAL security tools (Grype, Syft, Trivy, Semgrep, Gitleaks) - no mocked results
   - User confirmed SQLite for database and authorized installation of all missing tools
   - Current session focused on fixing backend server startup issues

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - Monorepo with npm workspaces (frontend, backend, shared packages)
   - Frontend: React 18 + Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS (dark-first theme), Monaco Editor, lazy loading
   - Backend: Fastify + TypeScript + Prisma ORM (SQLite dev, Postgres ready)
   - Job Queue: BullMQ + Redis for async processing with WebSocket real-time progress updates
   - AI Provider abstraction: AppsScriptProvider default, extensible for OpenAI/Gemini/Anthropic
   - Auth: JWT with refresh tokens, bcrypt password hashing
   - Shared types package: 1000+ lines covering all domain entities
   - Real security tool integration: Grype, Syft, Trivy, Semgrep, Gitleaks, kubeconform, checkov

3. Files and Code Sections:
   - backend/src/index.ts: Removed fastify-zod type provider, using plain Fastify with JSON schemas
   - backend/src/modules/auth/routes.ts: Converted loginSchema, registerSchema, refreshSchema, changePasswordSchema to JSON Schema objects
   - backend/src/modules/dockerfile/routes.ts: Converted scanSchema, fixSchema, imageScanSchema, imageFixSchema
   - backend/src/modules/docker/routes.ts: Converted scanSchema
   - backend/src/modules/kubernetes/routes.ts: Converted scanSchema, fixSchema, generateSchema
   - backend/src/modules/jenkins/routes.ts: Converted scanSchema, fixSchema, generateSchema, testConnectionSchema
   - backend/src/modules/github/routes.ts: Converted connectSchema, scanSchema, fixSchema, createPrSchema
   - backend/src/modules/logs/routes.ts: Converted searchSchema, investigateSchema
   - backend/src/modules/dependencies/routes.ts: Converted scanRepoSchema, scanManifestSchema, remediateSchema, exportSbomSchema
   - backend/src/modules/scans/routes.ts: Converted listSchema, batchDeleteSchema, exportSchema; fixed z.infer references
   - backend/src/modules/settings/routes.ts: Converted updateSettingsSchema, createApiKeySchema; fixed z.infer references
   - backend/src/modules/jobs/routes.ts: Converted listSchema
   - backend/src/modules/ai/routes.ts: Converted askSchema, fixSchema, explainSchema
   - backend/src/shared/utils/auth.ts: Fixed bcrypt import to use default export instead of dynamic import
   - backend/package.json: Added fastify-zod@1.4.0, downgraded zod@3.22.4, zod-to-json-schema@3.22.4, fastify-type-provider-zod@1.2.0

4. Errors and fixes:
   - Fastify zod schema validation error "data/required must be array": Fixed by converting all zod schemas to plain JSON Schema objects across all route files
   - bcrypt.hash is not a function: Fixed by changing dynamic import to static import of bcryptjs default export
   - fastify-zod v1.4.0 missing serializerCompiler/validatorCompiler exports: Removed fastify-zod type provider entirely since we're using raw JSON schemas
   - TypeScript build errors: Remaining z.infer<typeof schema> references in scans/routes.ts:141,164 and settings/routes.ts:152,219 need explicit TypeScript type annotations

5. Problem Solving:
   - Solved schema validation by eliminating zod-to-json-schema conversion entirely
   - All route schemas now use standard JSON Schema format compatible with Fastify's AJV validator
   - Backend server starts successfully on http://0.0.0.0:3001 with Redis running
   - Auth endpoints tested and working (register, login return JWT tokens)

6. All user messages:
   - Initial massive project specification (20+ features with exact requirements for each page, component, API endpoint)
   - "hi" greeting
   - "Which database?" → Answered: SQLite
   - "Install missing tools?" → Answered: Install all

7. Pending Tasks:
   - Fix TypeScript build errors in scans/routes.ts and settings/routes.ts (replace z.infer with explicit types)
   - Test backend build completes successfully (npm run build)
   - Implement Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml, .env.example for deployment
   - Test end-to-end workflows
   - Implement WebSocket real-time job progress updates in frontend hooks
   - Add proper error boundaries and loading states
   - Build frontend and integrate with backend

8. Current Work:
   - Fixed backend server startup by converting all zod schemas to JSON Schema objects across11 route modules
   - Server runs successfully with Redis, auth endpoints functional
   - Need to fix remaining TypeScript errors in scans/routes.ts (lines 141, 164) and settings/routes.ts (lines 152, 219) where z.infer<typeof schema> is used but zod schemas no longer exist

9. Optional Next Step:
   Fix the TypeScript build errors by replacing `z.infer<typeof batchDeleteSchema>` with `{ ids: string[] }` and `z.infer<typeof exportSchema>` with `{ format?: string; type?: string[]; status?: string[]; search?: string }` in scans/routes.ts, and `z.infer<typeof updateSettingsSchema>` and `z.infer<typeof createApiKeySchema>` with explicit TypeScript interfaces in settings/routes.ts. Then run `npm run build` to verify backend compiles.

## Summary

**Fixed the remaining TypeScript build errors:**

1. **settings/routes.ts** - Replaced `z.infer<typeof updateSettingsSchema>` and `z.infer<typeof createApiKeySchema>` with explicit TypeScript interfaces2. **index.ts** - Fixed the `authenticate` decorator to properly extract JWT payload and attach `request.user` with `{ userId, email, role }`

**Tested endpoints (all working):**
- `POST /api/auth/register` - User registration with JWT tokens
- `POST /api/auth/login` - User login 
- `GET /api/auth/me` - Get current user profile
- `GET /api/settings` - Get user settings
- `PATCH /api/settings` - Update settings (theme, sidebar, etc.)
- `POST /api/settings/api-keys` - Create API keys
- `GET /api/scans` - List scans with pagination
- `GET /api/jobs` - List jobs with pagination
- `POST /api/dockerfile/scan` - Queue Dockerfile scan job

content.thinking:
I see a critical bug in AuthContext.tsx: in `loadStoredAuth`, it calls `refreshUser()` — but `refreshUser` is defined AFTER `loadStoredAuth` with `const`. Since `loadStoredAuth` is a `useCallback` that references `refreshUser`, and `refreshUser` is a `const` function declared later... Actually, since `loadStoredAuth` only calls `refreshUser` at invocation time (inside useEffect), by then `refreshUser` would be defined. But wait — the closure captures the variable binding; since `loadStoredAuth` executes after render completes (in useEffect), `refreshUser` const will be initialized. That's fine.

But there's a bigger issue: the login response from backend is `{ user: {...}, accessToken, refreshToken }` — NOT `{ user, tokens }`. The backend returns `accessToken` and `refreshToken` directly in data, not a nested `tokens` object. So `tokensData` would be `undefined`, causing `localStorage.setItem('auth_tokens', JSON.stringify(undefined))` → stores "undefined", and api.defaults.headers set to "Bearer undefined". But that wouldn't cause a black screen on load.

```js
if (!mounted) {
```

Wait, but `mounted` is set to true in useEffect which runs after first render... Actually no — `setMounted(true)` in useEffect triggers re-render, so on the SECOND render mounted=true and provider exists. But the FIRST render has no provider. message.content:
This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.

Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   - Build a complete production-ready DevSecOps AI Platform with 9 major features (Dashboard, Dockerfile Fixer, Docker Image Scanner, Kubernetes YAML Assistant, Jenkins Assistant, GitHub Security, Log Investigation, Dependency Radar, Scan History) plus shared AI service, job queue, real-time updates, and modern SaaS UI
   - Must use REAL security tools (Grype, Syft, Trivy, Semgrep, Gitleaks) - no mocked results
   - User confirmed SQLite for database and authorized installation of all missing tools
   - Current session focused on fixing backend server startup issues and getting frontend working

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - Monorepo with npm workspaces (frontend, backend, shared packages)
   - Frontend: React 18 + Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS (dark-first theme), Monaco Editor, lazy loading
   - Backend: Fastify + TypeScript + Prisma ORM (SQLite dev, Postgres ready)
   - Job Queue: BullMQ + Redis for async processing with WebSocket real-time progress updates
   - AI Provider abstraction: AppsScriptProvider default, extensible for OpenAI/Gemini/Anthropic
   - Auth: JWT with refresh tokens, bcrypt password hashing
   - Shared types package: 1000+ lines covering all domain entities
   - Real security tool integration: Grype, Syft, Trivy, Semgrep, Gitleaks, kubeconform, checkov

3. Files and Code Sections:
   - backend/src/index.ts: Removed fastify-zod type provider, using plain Fastify with JSON schemas; fixed authenticate decorator to attach request.user
   - backend/src/modules/auth/routes.ts: Converted loginSchema, registerSchema, refreshSchema, changePasswordSchema to JSON Schema objects
   - backend/src/modules/dockerfile/routes.ts: Converted scanSchema, fixSchema, imageScanSchema, imageFixSchema
   - backend/src/modules/docker/routes.ts: Converted scanSchema
   - backend/src/modules/kubernetes/routes.ts: Converted scanSchema, fixSchema, generateSchema
   - backend/src/modules/jenkins/routes.ts: Converted scanSchema, fixSchema, generateSchema, testConnectionSchema
   - backend/src/modules/github/routes.ts: Converted connectSchema, scanSchema, fixSchema, createPrSchema
   - backend/src/modules/logs/routes.ts: Converted searchSchema, investigateSchema
   - backend/src/modules/dependencies/routes.ts: Converted scanRepoSchema, scanManifestSchema, remediateSchema, exportSbomSchema
   - backend/src/modules/scans/routes.ts: Converted listSchema, batchDeleteSchema, exportSchema; fixed z.infer references
   - backend/src/modules/settings/routes.ts: Converted updateSettingsSchema, createApiKeySchema; fixed z.infer references
   - backend/src/modules/jobs/routes.ts: Converted listSchema
   - backend/src/modules/ai/routes.ts: Converted askSchema, fixSchema, explainSchema
   - backend/src/shared/utils/auth.ts: Fixed bcrypt import to use default export instead of dynamic import
   - backend/package.json: Added fastify-zod@1.4.0, downgraded zod@3.22.4, zod-to-json-schema@3.22.4, fastify-type-provider-zod@1.2.0
   - frontend/src/index.css: Fixed Tailwind class names (bg-background-default → bg-background, text-foreground-default → text-foreground, etc.)
   - frontend/index.html: Fixed body class names
   - frontend/src/context/AuthContext.tsx: Fixed login/register to handle flat response structure, added loginWithTokens method, added updateProfile
   - frontend/src/pages/Login.tsx: Updated to use loginWithTokens, removed unused imports (Bitbucket, CheckCircle2, authApi)
   - frontend/src/pages/Register.tsx: Updated to use loginWithTokens, removed unused imports (Bitbucket, CheckCircle2, login)
   - frontend/src/services/api.ts: Added missing settingsApi methods (getAll, createApiKey, revokeApiKey, exportData, importData, deleteAccount, updateProfile), added scansApi.batchDelete and scansApi.export
   - frontend/src/pages/ScanHistory.tsx: Fixed ScanRecord → Scan, updated TYPE_ICONS and TYPE_LABELS to match ScanType enum, fixed filter types, fixed duration and metadata access
   - frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Fixed bg-background-default → bg-background
   - frontend/src/components/LoadingScreen.tsx: Fixed bg-background-default → bg-background
   - frontend/src/pages/LogInvestigation.tsx: Fixed bg-background-default → bg-background

4. Errors and fixes:
   - Fastify zod schema validation error "data/required must be array": Fixed by converting all zod schemas to plain JSON Schema objects across all route files
   - bcrypt.hash is not a function: Fixed by changing dynamic import to static import of bcryptjs default export
   - fastify-zod v1.4.0 missing serializerCompiler/validatorCompiler exports: Removed fastify-zod type provider entirely since we're using raw JSON schemas
   - TypeScript build errors: Remaining z.infer<typeof schema> references in scans/routes.ts:141,164 and settings/routes.ts:152,219 needed explicit TypeScript type annotations - FIXED
   - Frontend "The `bg-background-default` class does not exist": Fixed by updating all Tailwind class names to match config (background.DEFAULT → bg-background, foreground.DEFAULT → text-foreground)

This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.

Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   - Fix remaining TypeScript build errors in frontend pages to complete a successful production build
   - The user previously confirmed SQLite for database and authorized installation of all missing security tools (Grype, Syft, Trivy, Semgrep, Gitleaks)
   - Current focus: Resolve all TypeScript compilation errors across frontend components and pages

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - Monorepo with npm workspaces (frontend, backend, shared packages)
   - Frontend: React 18 + Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS (dark-first theme), Monaco Editor
   - Backend: Fastify + TypeScript + Prisma ORM (SQLite dev, Postgres ready)
   - Job Queue: BullMQ + Redis for async processing with WebSocket real-time updates
   - AI Provider abstraction: AppsScriptProvider default, extensible for OpenAI/Gemini/Anthropic
   - Auth: JWT with refresh tokens, bcrypt password hashing
   - Shared types package with 1000+ lines covering all domain entities
   - Real security tool integration: Grype, Syft, Trivy, Semgrep, Gitleaks, kubeconform, checkov

3. Files and Code Sections:
   - frontend/src/components/CodeEditor.tsx: Fixed unused imports, onChange type signature, removed invalid props (minHeight, onBeforeUnmount, onSave)
   - frontend/src/components/DiffViewer.tsx: Removed unused imports, fixed viewMode type comparison issues, fixed renderLineNumber call
   - frontend/src/components/FindingCard.tsx: Removed unused Copy import
   - frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Removed 10+ unused imports, removed 6 unused state variables, renamed update to _update
   - frontend/src/components/LoadingScreen.tsx: Removed unused React import
   - frontend/src/components/UserMenu.tsx: Removed unused useAuth import, added useState, removed unused resolvedTheme
   - frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Removed unused imports (LayoutDashboard, Zap, notificationsApi, TableSkeleton), removed unused error state, added type annotations to reduce callbacks, added Zap import back
   - frontend/src/hooks/useWebSocket.ts: Fixed import.meta.env type issue with casting
   - Previously fixed: Register.tsx, Settings.tsx, LogInvestigation.tsx, JenkinsAssistant.tsx, KubernetesAssistant.tsx, Login.tsx, AuthContext.tsx, ScanHistory.tsx

4. Errors and fixes:
   - TS6133 (unused imports/variables): Fixed across all files by removing unused imports and state variables
   - TS2304 (cannot find name): Fixed authApi imports in Login/Register, added Zap import in Dashboard
   - TS2322 (type assignment): Fixed CodeEditor onChange to accept string | undefined, removed invalid minHeight/onBeforeUnmount props
   - TS2367 (type comparison): Fixed DiffViewer viewMode comparison by removing explicit type annotation

export async function dockerfileRoutes(app: FastifyInstance) {
  // Scan Dockerfile
  app.post('/scan', {
    preHandler: [app.authenticate],
    schema: { body: scanSchema }
  }, async (request, reply) => {
    const userId = (request as any).user.userId;
    const { content, targetName, fix } = request.body as { content: string; targetName?: string; fix?: boolean };

    // Create scan record
    const scan = await prisma.scan.create({
      data: {
        type: 'dockerfile',
        status: 'pending',
        targetType: 'dockerfile',
        targetValue: targetName || 'Dockerfile',
        targetMeta: JSON.stringify({ content }),
        userId
      }
    });

    // Create job
    const jobId = await createJob({
      type: 'dockerfile_scan',
      input: { content },
      userId,
      scanId: scan.id
    });

    await prisma.scan.update({
      where: { id: scan.id },
      data: { jobId: jobId }
    });

    await auditLog(request, 'DOCKERFILE_SCAN_STARTED', 'scan', scan.id, { targetName });

    return { success: true, data: { scanId: scan.id, jobId: jobId } };
  });

  // Scan Docker Image
  app.post('/scan-image', {
    preHandler: [app.authenticate],
    schema: { body: imageScanSchema }
  }, async (request, reply) => {
    const userId = (request as any).user.userId;
    const { imageName, targetName } = request.body as { imageName: string; targetName?: string };

    // Create scan record
    const scan = await prisma.scan.create({
      data: {
        type: 'docker_image',
        status: 'pending',
        targetType: 'docker_image',
        targetValue: targetName || imageName,
        targetMeta: JSON.stringify({ imageName }),
        userId
      }
    });

    // Create job
    const jobId = await createJob({
      type: 'docker_image_scan',
      input: { imageName },
      userId,
      scanId: scan.id
    });

    await prisma.scan.update({
      where: { id: scan.id },
      data: { jobId }
    });

    await auditLog(request, 'DOCKER_IMAGE_SCAN_STARTED', 'scan', scan.id, { imageName });

    return { success: true, data: { scanId: scan.id, jobId } };
  });

  // Fix Dockerfile
  app.post('/fix', {
    preHandler: [app.authenticate],
    schema: { body: fixSchema }
  }, async (request, reply) => {
    const userId = (request as any).user.userId;
    const { scanId, findings } = request.body as { scanId: string; findings?: any[] };

    const scan = await prisma.scan.findUnique({
      where: { id: scanId },
      include: { findings: true }
    });

    if (!scan || scan.userId !== userId) {
      return reply.code(404).send({ success: false, error: { code: 'NOT_FOUND', message: 'Scan not found', statusCode: 404 } });
    }

    const dockerfile = (scan.targetMeta as any)?.content || '';

    const jobId = await createJob({
      type: 'dockerfile_fix',
      input: { content: dockerfile, findings: findings || scan.findings },
      userId,
      scanId
    });

    await auditLog(request, 'DOCKERFILE_FIX_STARTED', 'scan', scanId);

    return { success: true, data: { jobId } };
  });

  // Fix Docker Image (base image upgrade)
  app.post('/fix-image', {
    preHandler: [app.authenticate],
    schema: { body: imageFixSchema }
  }, async (request, reply) => {
    const userId = (request as any).user.userId;
    const { scanId, dockerfile, vulnerabilities } = request.body as { scanId: string; dockerfile: string; vulnerabilities?: any[] };

    const scan = await prisma.scan.findUnique({
      where: { id: scanId },
      include: { findings: true }
    });

    if (!scan || scan.userId !== userId) {
      return reply.code(404).send({ success: false, error: { code: 'NOT_FOUND', message: 'Scan not found', statusCode: 404 } });
    }

    const jobId = await createJob({
      type: 'docker_image_fix',
      input: { dockerfile, vulnerabilities: vulnerabilities || scan.findings },
      userId,
      scanId
    });

    await auditLog(request, 'DOCKER_IMAGE_FIX_STARTED', 'scan', scanId);

    return { success: true, data: { jobId } };
  });

  // Get scan results
  app.get('/scan/:id', {
    preHandler: [app.authenticate]
  }, async (request, reply) => {
    const userId = (request as any).user.userId;
    const { id } = request.params as { id: string };

    const scan = await prisma.scan.findUnique({
      where: { id },
      include: { findings: { orderBy: [{ severity: 'desc' }, { createdAt: 'desc' }] } }
    });

    if (!scan || scan.userId !== userId) {
      return reply.code(404).send({ success: false, error: { code: 'NOT_FOUND', message: 'Scan not found', statusCode: 404 } });
    }

    return { success: true, data: scan };
  });
